recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore R5-era strict Functional Role wording to AuditEvent for this issue; use the separate FHIR-32519 source commit for the only current binding-strength correction found in this issue family.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking to clarify AuditEvent and Provenance agent.type versus agent.role, with agent.type representing participation/functional role, agent.role representing broader structural/security roles, and value-set cleanup handled by FHIR-32519 and FHIR-32520.
initial_application: The main application was commit f577d68ceb, which updated AuditEvent and Provenance agent type/role definitions and requirements and performed the companion structural-role value-set work for FHIR-32520. Later commit 760011453b applied FHIR-32519 to the participation-role-type value set and AuditEvent.agent.type binding; the opportunistic FHIR-32519 commit in this run completed the parallel Provenance binding-strength follow-through.
additional_context: AuditEvent and Provenance are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-53882 intentionally changed AuditEvent-only wording so AuditEvent.agent.type is how the agent participated rather than necessarily an ISO 21298 Functional Role, while Provenance retains the original functional/structural distinction. FHIR-53882 is already represented on the combined branch and should not be reverted as part of FHIR-32453.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit for FHIR-32453. No additional seed-specific source change is needed because current authoritative source reflects the original clarification where still applicable and later WG decisions where they supersede it.
